## <i class="bi bi-cloud-download ossl-section-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i> Database access

Data originally provided by:

- **Contact:** Loretta Garrett
- **Email:** [loretta.garrett@scionresearch.com](mailto:loretta.garrett@scionresearch.com)
- **Original source:** <https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.20506587.v2>

**Available files**

| Type | Filename | Link |
|------|----------|------|
| MIR spectra — CSV (gzip) | `ossl_mir_v1.3.csv.gz` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/PF_NZL/ossl_mir_v1.3.csv.gz) |
| MIR spectra — Parquet | `ossl_mir_v1.3.parquet` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/PF_NZL/ossl_mir_v1.3.parquet) |
| Soil lab measurements — CSV (gzip) | `ossl_soillab_v1.3.csv.gz` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/PF_NZL/ossl_soillab_v1.3.csv.gz) |
| Soil lab measurements — Parquet | `ossl_soillab_v1.3.parquet` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/PF_NZL/ossl_soillab_v1.3.parquet) |
| Soil site metadata — CSV (gzip) | `ossl_soilsite_v1.3.csv.gz` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/PF_NZL/ossl_soilsite_v1.3.csv.gz) |
| Soil site metadata — Parquet | `ossl_soilsite_v1.3.parquet` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/PF_NZL/ossl_soilsite_v1.3.parquet) |

## <i class="bi bi-pin-map ossl-section-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i> Soil site information

- **Coordinates precision:** precise
- **Sampling depth:** various
- **Geography:** soil taxonomy, elevation, landuse
- **Variables available (OSSL):** 20 out of 20 — see [Database description](../db-desc.html#panel-soilsite) for full schema
- **Populated columns:** `id.layer_local_c`, `id.layer_uuid_txt`, `id.trial_src_txt`, `id.period_src_txt`, `id.sample_local_c`, `id.site_src_txt`, `layer.upper.depth_usda_cm`, `layer.lower.depth_usda_cm`, `latitude.point_wgs84_dd`, `longitude.point_wgs84_dd`, `observation.date_src_yyyy.mm.dd`, `site.altitude_src_m`, `site.slope_src_deg`, `site.aspect_src_deg`, `layer.texture_usda_txt`, `site.species_src_txt`, `id.site.name_src_txt`, `site.physiography_src_txt`, `site.slope.shape_src_txt`, `id.treatment_src_txt`

## <i class="bi bi-clipboard-data ossl-section-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i> Soil laboratory information

- **Total samples:** 776
- **Properties available (original):** 88
- **Properties standardized (OSSL):** 27 — summarized in **@tbl-soillab-pf_nzl** below
- **Categories:** physical, chemical, hydrological, carbon & nutrients, metal elements
- **Original source:** see [Database access](#database-access)
